verdict.rationale: The Texas Comptroller is a government service, not an agent, so whether it publishes an official MCP server is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows one exists. The probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec. The keyless Socrata SODA open-data endpoint is a read-only data API, which is a developer building block rather than an MCP server, so it earns no credit.
